posts.name: The Conscience
posts.cooked:
For those of you that are interested in this sort of thing I am currently working on a totally original RPG for SotM and have made a lot of progress.

I should have something to present to Chris and the gang by GenCon and if anyone is interested in playtesting this version at GenCon, please don’t hesitate to volunteer. I am always willing to indoctrinate new victims into the machine that is RPG’s.

The core mechanics are done and I am just working on Powers and Abilities now.

This is in no way a response to the other thread of converting the characters to M&M as I started this project last year.
